title: 第2653章 凭你这样的蝼蚁也敢针对人族第2652章 天寂古城重现鬼域
lines: 天穹上。
无数鬼域修士抬头望向天穹。
随着那浩瀚的金色火海降临，唐明矗立于虚空，眉心处闪烁着圣巫图腾。
他一步踏出。
“轰隆！”
虚空猛然震荡。
人王之座迎风暴涨。
在人王之力的加持下，唐明气息愈加磅礴，翻手间，一道璀璨剑光蓦然绽放，化作一片弥漫数百公里的浩瀚剑域。
紧接着。
天寂古城迎风暴涨。
唐明口吐一字，修罗神狱铺开，一道道剑光狠狠钉入虚空中，稳住了金色火海的下坠之势。
随后。
天寂魂兽张开血盆大口，周身缭绕着寂灭气息，源源不断的吞噬着金色火海。
“哗啦啦！”
“哗啦！”
虚空中传来阵阵爆鸣。
金色火海的体积不断减弱。
“得救了！”
“唐青冥的实力，竟如此恐怖！”
“我听说，之前唐青冥还潜入天冥城，成为窦天罡麾下的血鸣军将领，但最后却叛逃了血鸣军。”
“叛逃？他窦天罡才是最大的叛徒，勾结仙界，天冥城破他就是最大的罪魁祸首！”
“不错，而且论身份，他窦天罡不过是仗着天冥老祖的威风罢了，可唐青冥却是正统的天寂城新任城主，是与天冥老祖平起平坐的存在。”
“是啊，唐青冥执掌天寂本源，放在上古乃至太古时代，那都是绝对的幽冥统治者。”
“如若唐青冥与天冥老祖能同时坐镇幽冥，在天冥本源与天寂本源的加持下，我们鬼域修士必将崛起！”
“有道理……”
诸多鬼域修士议论纷纷。
无论是人王之座，还是太古圣巫法相，都不如天寂城来得震撼。
身为幽冥三大本源，天寂本源的存在，那便是最纯粹，最正统的幽冥本源。
“轰隆！”
“嘭嘭嘭！”
覆盖整片天穹的金色火海，飞速消散。
天冥城，以及十几亿鬼域修士的危机，就此化解。
诸多鬼域修士，感激的看向高空，看向那道伟岸的身躯。
天冥老祖腾空而起，双手抱拳，躬身一拜：“多谢唐道友鼎力相助，此番若非你出手相助，我必将遭受苍隗毒害。”
“还有天冥城十几亿鬼域修士，也都因你而获救。”
“唐道友，此番大恩大德，幽冥界域将铭记于心。”
content_en:
On the sky.
Countless ghost realm monks looked up to the sky.
As the vast sea of ​​golden fire descended, Tang Ming stood in the void, with the holy witch totem flashing between his eyebrows.
He took one step forward.
"Boom!"
The void suddenly shook.
The throne of the king of men rises in the storm.
With the blessing of the human king's power, Tang Ming's aura became more majestic. With a flip of his hand, a bright sword light suddenly bloomed, turning into a vast sword field that spread hundreds of kilometers.
Immediately afterwards.
The ancient city of Tianji rises in the storm.
"Town!"
Tang Ming uttered a word, and the Shura Divine Prison spread out, and sword lights stabbed into the void, stabilizing the falling force of the golden sea of fire.
Subsequently.
The Heavenly Silent Soul Beast opened its bloody mouth, the aura of annihilation lingered around its body, and it continuously devoured the golden sea of ​​fire.
"Crash!"
"Wow!"
There were bursts of explosions in the void.
The volume of the golden sea of ​​fire continued to weaken.
"Saved!"
"Tang Qingming's strength is so terrifying!"
"I heard that Tang Qingming sneaked into Tianming City and became the general of the Xueming Army under Dou Tiangang, but in the end he defected from the Xueming Army."
"Defection? He, Dou Tiangang, is the biggest traitor. He colluded with the immortal world, and he is the biggest culprit for the destruction of Tianming City!"
"Yes, and in terms of status, Dou Tiangang is just relying on the majesty of Patriarch Tianming, but Tang Qingming is the orthodox new city lord of Tianji City, and he is on an equal footing with Patriarch Tianming."
"Yes, Tang Qingming is in charge of the origin of Tianji. In ancient times and even in the ancient times, he was the absolute ruler of the Netherworld."
"If Tang Qingming and Tianming Ancestor can take control of Netherworld at the same time, with the blessing of Tianming's origin and Tianji's origin, we ghost realm monks will surely rise!"
"That makes sense..."
Many ghost realm monks were talking about it.
Whether it is the throne of the human king or the ancient holy wizard and dharma image, they are not as shocking as Tianji City.
As the three major sources of the Netherworld, the existence of the Source of Tianji is the purest and most orthodox source of the Netherworld.
…
"Boom!"
"Bang bang bang!"
The golden sea of fire covering the entire sky quickly dissipated.
The crisis in Tianming City and the more than one billion monks in the ghost realm has been resolved.
Many ghost realm monks looked up to the sky with gratitude, looking at that majestic body.
"Uh-huh!"
Ancestor Tianming rose into the air, cupped his fists with both hands, and bowed: "Thank you, fellow Taoist Tang, for your help. If you hadn't helped me this time, I would have been poisoned by Cang Wei."
"There are also more than a billion ghost realm monks in Tianming City, all of whom were saved because of you."
"Fellow Taoist Tang, this great kindness and kindness will be remembered in the Netherworld Realm."
title_en: Chapter 2653: How dare an ant like you target the human race? Chapter 2652: Tianji Ancient City reappears in the ghost realm
